surnameVariantHints.note: This search did not identify the subject under the surname(s) as written. Scandinavian clerks abbreviated the patronymic ending -datter/-dotter ('daughter') as dr., dtr. or d., and indexes transcribe the abbreviation without the period. args.description: Search Fluvanna census and death records
args.prompt:
Run plan item pli_001: find the subject in the Fluvanna County, Virginia censuses after 1900 (1910-1930), and in Virginia death records if she died after 1912. She is the widowed midwife enumerated in 1900 in Cunningham District as '[given name blank] Tyler', female, black, born April 1853 (ark:/61903/1:1:MMF1-WWF). Her 1900 household: Dora Lightfoot (b. Jan 1885), William E Lightfoot (b. Oct 1872), Mary Dillard (b. Jan 1895), Emma Winston (b. Feb 1895). Her given name is in doubt; readings include Ann and Antone.

- Candidate 1: Antone Lightfoot, 1910 census, Cunningham, widowed, female, Mulatto, indexed birth 1837. Birth year is 16 years off the subject's Apr 1853, a birthYearConflict. Surname differs. Not adopted.
- Candidate 2: Ann Tone Lightfoot, death 29 Oct 1923 in Cunningham, indexed birth 1833, Virginia Death Certificates 1912-1987. Birth year is 20 years off and surname differs. Needs-review; this is the only death-after-1912 lead and it is not established as the subject.
- No sources or assertions exist; no extraction was run.
- pli_001 status: in_progress.
- No namesake rows written; the candidates carry a different surname from the subject's.
- The Virginia death-record check after 1912 is not part of pli_001 (census only) and was not run.
- Hand-back: search-external-sites — FamilySearch variants for Ann or Antone Tyler in Fluvanna 1910-1930 are exhausted. Subject: Ann Tyler, female, b. Apr 1853 Virginia, widowed midwife, Cunningham district in 1900 with a Lightfoot household. Plan item pli_001, userPresent yes.

I could not find the midwife under Tyler in the 1910, 1920 or 1930 Fluvanna censuses, under either given-name reading (Ann or Antone), or with the surname alone. Searches that used the Lightfoot names from her 1900 household returned no one matching her, and the only leads carry a different surname and birth years 16 to 20 years away from hers, so I have not connected either to her. Next, other genealogy websites will be checked for these records.
